using Makie
function makeplot(data)
    fig = Figure(size=(900,500),fontsize=16)
    ax1 = Axis(fig[1,1];title="Envelope check",xlabel="Time",ylabel="Signal",xscale=identity,yscale=identity)
    ax2 = Axis(fig[1,2];title="Envelope check",xlabel="Time",ylabel="Signal",xscale=identity,yscale=identity)
    band!(ax1,data["x"],data["lo"],data["hi"];color="#D55E00",alpha=0.25,label="Range")
    lines!(ax2,data["x"],data["a"];color="#D55E00",linewidth=2.5,label="Center")
    linkxaxes!(ax1,ax2)
    ax1.legend = AxisLegend(ax1;position=:rt,framevisible=false)
    ax2.legend = AxisLegend(ax2;position=:rt,framevisible=false)
    return fig
end
